meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 把项目的 claude-mem 历史时间线按 ISO 周拆成多个文件,再按周依次运行子代理,每个子代理读取上一周的剧情摘要,每周写一章叙述,最终输出一份多章的连载式项目周报及索引。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成“weekly digests”、“week-by-week story”等按周连载的项目历史叙述时触发。

say.text: 请为这个项目生成每周连载摘要,每周一章。
say.note: 将启动逐周子代理管道。

say.text: 把项目历史按周拆成故事章节。
say.note: 会先分割时间线再逐周叙述。

say.text: 按周连载讲讲这个项目的开发过程。
say.note: 触发同样流程,章数由周数决定。

howto.what_en: Splits a project's claude-mem timeline into ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week (each receiving the prior week's carry-forward) to produce one narrative chapter per week, plus an index.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', 'serial timeline', or similar serial chapter narration of a project's history.

say_en.text: Please make weekly digests for this project, one chapter per week.
Break the project's history into weekly story chapters.
say_en.note: Splits the timeline, then narrates per week.

say_en.text: Tell the project's development story week by week.
say_en.note: Same flow; chapter count equals week count.
